title: 636017 Move Purchases report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Tooltips for 18 purchase-related reports are now defined on the report objects themselves rather than on the page actions that invoke them, eliminating duplication across W1 and all country layers.
key_points: Moved tooltip definitions from page actions to 18 report objects covering purchase statistics, vendor statements, and deletion reports
Removed duplicate tooltip text from page actions in W1 and 55 page forks across 18 country layers
Added report-level tooltips to 8 forked report objects to maintain consistency
Metadata-only change with no runtime behavior impact
Follows established cleanup pattern already applied to warehouse, manufacturing, service, sales and inventory modules
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for the Purchases reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves
